## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

detailed_description:
The target video is a 3:4 vertical surreal fashion advertisement blending photorealistic street footage with explosive UV fluorescent outline-line paint effects: vines, leaves, and flowers are rendered not as solid paint but as glowing neon contour strokes in saturated magenta, cyan, lime, and electric orange — luminous line-art tendrils that trace the edges of real objects, burst outward in crackling spark-line explosions, and keep growing as animated hand-drawn outlines over the live-action world. No text, captions, logos, watermarks, or any other written characters appear anywhere in the frame throughout the entire video. The sidewalk and street ground stay photorealistic, dry, and clean at all times: no colored ink, paint stain, glowing stroke, or outline effect ever appears on the ground surface, and all vine and line effects are confined to the walls, facades, air, plants, clothing, and . On the faces of  and , only soft fluorescent light glow is allowed; no paint, ink, or drawn lines ever touch their skin.
[Shot 1] The video begins from :  and  stand linked-arm before a tall black door set in a beige stone facade, soft overcast daylight,  facing the lens with a calm poised look while  turns toward her with a faint knowing smile. They exchange a glance, their smiles widen, they link arms tighter and step forward together; the vertical camera tracks backward at walking pace, crisp footsteps on stone audible.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle full shot following both women from the front. With each step, glowing magenta and cyan outline-line vines burst from cracks along the stone facades and doorways, exploding upward in slow-motion spark-line bursts, contour tendrils spiraling beside their legs and crawling up the walls to bloom as luminous line-drawn lime flowers, while the sidewalk under their shoes stays photorealistic and completely free of any stroke or ink. 's eyes widen, brows shoot up and her mouth opens in delighted surprise; she glances at a contour vine winding past her jacket and says in a bright young female voice, [Chinese] 你看，线条活过来了！
[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the shot cuts to a close-up two-shot of both faces with rich, lively expressions. Only light affects their faces: neon magenta and cyan glow from the blooming vines reflects and drifts across their features, glowing pollen-like particles float past their hair, and a soft fluorescent rim light grazes their cheeks, with no paint, ink, or drawn lines on their skin.  breaks into an open-mouthed laugh, eyes crinkling with delight, while  answers with a playful raised-brow smirk that melts into a warm laugh, tilting her head toward her friend, saying in a calm amused voice, [Chinese] 那就让它疯长吧。
[Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a macro close-up of  swinging gently at 's hip. Glowing outline-line vines trace the bag's leather seams and edges, luminous contour tendrils wrap the thin strap, and line-art blossoms in magenta and lime bloom across the slouchy cognac leather, each sprout synced to a wet paint crackle and fizzing spark burst while the leather grain and sheen stay fully photorealistic.  says off-screen with an amused laugh, [Chinese] 连我的包都开花了。
[Shot 5] At 00:09.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot tracking beside the pair as they walk arm in arm. Glowing contour vines loop over their shoulders and connect the two jackets like a living neon thread, line-drawn petals detaching and drifting past their hair. Both women turn to each other laughing richly —  grinning with squinted joyful eyes,  answering with an exaggerated theatrical bow of the head mid-stride.  says playfully, [Chinese] 整条街都在给我们让路。
[Shot 6] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a wide vertical long shot: the whole street has become a surreal outline-line fluorescent jungle, facades covered in glowing contour vines and oversized line-drawn blooms in magenta, cyan, and lime while the sky stays realistically overcast and the ground remains clean and photorealistic without any stroke, ink, or paint effect. The two women walk away from camera down the center of the street, glancing back over their shoulders with big beaming smiles, silhouettes rim-lit by the neon line growth, with no text or graphics on screen.  says off-screen, [Chinese] 走出我们的超现实。

overall_soundscape:
Dry autumn street ambience with distant city traffic continues throughout the video; two sets of crisp footsteps on stone, one pair of flats and one pair of suede shoes; electric sizzling line-tracing sounds, crackling spark pops, and soft blooming whooshes synchronize with each outline-vine explosion; leather creak and soft fabric rustle under the bag close-up; the women's light laughter weaves between dialogue lines.

non_diegetic_music:
A slow-building electronic score: sparse plucked synth and sub-bass pulses at first, adding glitchy arpeggios and a steady kick from [Shot 2], swelling into wide neon synth pads with shimmering hi-hats for [Shot 6], then cutting to a single sustained pad note under the final wide shot.
